name: branding-bakery-cartoon-mascots-tote-and-condensed-wordmark
title: Red-and-cream bakery identity with condensed wordmark and line-drawn croissant mascots
whatItIs: A split image: left, a model carrying a cream tote printed in red with tall condensed 'MR.CROISSANT', a croissant badge and three line-drawn beret-wearing figures holding hands, on a black and red backdrop; right, two cream cards on black with the same wordmark and small addresses.
whatItMeans: Charming, witty and Parisian; a limited red on cream keeps it simple and confident.
techniques: Combine a condensed sans wordmark with a light serif for the secondary text.
Draw mascots in one line weight with a red stroke.
Use only one ink colour on cream stock.
Stage the mockup on a dark background so the cream pops.

vocabulary.definition: A brand printed in a single colour.
A character drawn with a single-weight outline.
A small oval containing a symbol.
